description: Mistral Large 2 is Mistral AI's flagship 123B parameter model with 128K context window. It offers advanced multilingual support across 12 languages, native function calling, and state-of-the-art reasoning capabilities designed for agentic workflows.

trainingData.description: Trained on multilingual data covering 12 languages. 80+ programming languages supported.

trainingProcedure: Instruction tuning with focus on multilingual capabilities and function calling.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art performance for its size. Competitive with GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 on reasoning benchmarks.

knownLimitations: Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning and content filtering applied.
